description: Orchestrator HTTP, CLI and Web contract. Update this file and run make api-contract.

commands.name: relocate
commands.summary: Relocate a replica beneath another instance

commands.name: relocate-replicas
commands.summary: Relocates all or part of the replicas of a given instance under another instance

commands.name: take-siblings
commands.summary: Turn all siblings of a replica into its sub-replicas.

commands.name: regroup-replicas
commands.summary: Given an instance, pick one of its replicas and make it local master of its siblings

commands.name: move-up
commands.summary: Move a replica one level up the topology

commands.name: move-up-replicas
commands.summary: Moves replicas of the given instance one level up the topology

commands.name: move-below
commands.summary: Moves a replica beneath its sibling. Both replicas must be actively replicating from same master.

commands.name: move-equivalent
commands.summary: Moves a replica beneath another server, based on previously recorded "equivalence coordinates"

commands.name: repoint
commands.summary: Make the given instance replicate from another instance without changing the binglog coordinates. Use with care

commands.name: repoint-replicas
commands.summary: Repoint all replicas of given instance to replicate back from the instance. Use with care

commands.name: take-master
commands.summary: Turn an instance into a master of its own master; essentially switch the two.

commands.name: make-co-master
commands.summary: Create a master-master replication. Given instance is a replica which replicates directly from a master.

commands.name: get-candidate-replica
commands.summary: Information command suggesting the most up-to-date replica of a given instance that is good for promotion

commands.name: regroup-replicas-bls
commands.summary: Regroup Binlog Server replicas of a given instance

commands.name: move-gtid
commands.summary: Move a replica beneath another instance.

commands.name: move-replicas-gtid
commands.summary: Moves all replicas of a given instance under another (destination) instance using GTID

commands.name: regroup-replicas-gtid
commands.summary: Given an instance, pick one of its replica and make it local master of its siblings, using GTID.

commands.name: match
commands.summary: Matches a replica beneath another (destination) instance using Pseudo-GTID

commands.name: match-up
commands.summary: Transport the replica one level up the hierarchy, making it child of its grandparent, using Pseudo-GTID

commands.name: rematch
commands.summary: Reconnect a replica onto its master, via PSeudo-GTID.

commands.name: match-replicas
commands.summary: Matches all replicas of a given instance under another (destination) instance using Pseudo-GTID

commands.name: match-up-replicas
commands.summary: Matches replicas of the given instance one level up the topology, making them siblings of given instance, using Pseudo-GTID

commands.name: regroup-replicas-pgtid
commands.summary: Given an instance, pick one of its replica and make it local master of its siblings, using Pseudo-GTID.

commands.name: enable-gtid
commands.summary: If possible, turn on GTID replication

commands.name: disable-gtid
commands.summary: Turn off GTID replication, back to file:pos replication

commands.name: which-gtid-errant
commands.summary: Get errant GTID set (empty results if no errant GTID)

commands.name: gtid-errant-reset-master
commands.summary: Reset master on instance, remove GTID errant transactions

commands.name: skip-query
commands.summary: Skip a single statement on a replica; either when running with GTID or without

commands.name: stop-replica
commands.summary: Issue a STOP SLAVE on an instance

commands.name: start-replica
commands.summary: Issue a START SLAVE on an instance

commands.name: restart-replica
commands.summary: STOP and START SLAVE on an instance

commands.name: reset-replica
commands.summary: Issues a RESET SLAVE command; use with care

commands.name: change-master-credentials
commands.summary: Re-apply replication user/password (and SSL material, if ReplicationCredentialsQuery provides it) on an instance while preserving its existing SOURCE_SSL/TLS configuration.

commands.name: detach-replica-master-host
commands.summary: Stops replication and modifies Master_Host into an impossible, yet reversible, value.

commands.name: reattach-replica-master-host
commands.summary: Undo a detach-replica-master-host operation

commands.name: master-pos-wait
commands.summary: Wait until replica reaches given replication coordinates (--binlog=file:pos)

commands.name: enable-semi-sync-master
commands.summary: Enable semi-sync replication (master-side)

commands.name: disable-semi-sync-master
commands.summary: Disable semi-sync replication (master-side)

commands.name: enable-semi-sync-replica
commands.summary: Enable semi-sync replication (replica-side)

commands.name: disable-semi-sync-replica
commands.summary: Disable semi-sync replication (replica-side)

commands.name: restart-replica-statements
commands.summary: Get a list of statements to execute to stop then restore replica to same execution state. Provide --statement for injected statement

commands.name: can-replicate-from
commands.summary: Can an instance (-i) replicate from another (-d) according to replication rules? Prints 'true|false'

commands.name: is-replicating
commands.summary: Is an instance (-i) actively replicating right now

commands.name: is-replication-stopped
commands.summary: Is an instance (-i) a replica with both replication threads stopped

commands.name: set-read-only
commands.summary: Turn an instance read-only, via SET GLOBAL read_only := 1

commands.name: set-writeable
commands.summary: Turn an instance writeable, via SET GLOBAL read_only := 0

commands.name: flush-binary-logs
commands.summary: Flush binary logs on an instance

commands.name: purge-binary-logs
commands.summary: Purge binary logs of an instance

commands.name: last-pseudo-gtid
commands.summary: Find latest Pseudo-GTID entry in instance's binary logs

commands.name: locate-gtid-errant
commands.summary: List binary logs containing errant GTIDs

commands.name: last-executed-relay-entry
commands.summary: Find coordinates of last executed relay log entry

commands.name: correlate-relaylog-pos
commands.summary: Given an instance (-i) and relaylog coordinates (--binlog=file:pos), find the correlated coordinates in another instance's relay logs (-d)

commands.name: find-binlog-entry
commands.summary: Get binlog file:pos of entry given by --pattern (exact full match, not a regular expression) in a given instance

commands.name: correlate-binlog-pos
commands.summary: Given an instance (-i) and binlog coordinates (--binlog=file:pos), find the correlated coordinates in another instance (-d)

commands.name: submit-pool-instances
commands.summary: Submit a pool name with a list of instances in that pool

commands.name: cluster-pool-instances
commands.summary: List all pools and their associated instances

commands.name: which-heuristic-cluster-pool-instances
commands.summary: List instances of a given cluster which are in either any pool or in a specific pool

commands.name: find
commands.summary: Find instances whose hostname matches given regex pattern

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Search instances by name, version, version comment, port

commands.name: clusters
commands.summary: List all clusters known to orchestrator

commands.name: clusters-alias
commands.summary: List all clusters known to orchestrator

commands.name: all-clusters-masters
commands.summary: List of writeable masters, one per cluster

commands.name: topology
commands.summary: Show an ascii-graph of a replication topology, given a member of that topology

commands.name: topology-tabulated
commands.summary: Show an ascii-graph of a replication topology, given a member of that topology

commands.name: topology-tags
commands.summary: Show an ascii-graph of a replication topology and instance tags, given a member of that topology

commands.name: all-instances
commands.summary: The complete list of known instances

commands.name: which-instance
commands.summary: Output the fully-qualified hostname:port representation of the given instance, or error if unknown

commands.name: which-cluster
commands.summary: Output the name of the cluster an instance belongs to, or error if unknown to orchestrator

commands.name: which-cluster-alias
commands.summary: Output the alias of the cluster an instance belongs to, or error if unknown to orchestrator

commands.name: which-cluster-domain
commands.summary: Output the domain name of the cluster an instance belongs to, or error if unknown to orchestrator

commands.name: which-heuristic-domain-instance
commands.summary: Returns the instance associated as the cluster's writer with a cluster's domain name.

commands.name: which-cluster-master
commands.summary: Output the name of the master in a given cluster

commands.name: which-cluster-instances
commands.summary: Output the list of instances participating in same cluster as given instance

commands.name: which-cluster-osc-replicas
commands.summary: Output a list of replicas in a cluster, that could serve as a pt-online-schema-change operation control replicas

commands.name: which-cluster-gh-ost-replicas
commands.summary: Output a list of replicas in a cluster, that could serve as a gh-ost working server

commands.name: which-master
commands.summary: Output the fully-qualified hostname:port representation of a given instance's master

commands.name: which-downtimed-instances
commands.summary: List instances currently downtimed, potentially filtered by cluster

commands.name: which-replicas
commands.summary: Output the fully-qualified hostname:port list of replicas of a given instance

commands.name: which-lost-in-recovery
commands.summary: List instances marked as downtimed for being lost in a recovery process

commands.name: instance-status
commands.summary: Output short status on a given instance

commands.name: get-cluster-heuristic-lag
commands.summary: For a given cluster (indicated by an instance or alias), output a heuristic "representative" lag of that cluster

commands.name: submit-masters-to-kv-stores
commands.summary: Submit master of a specific cluster, or all masters of all clusters to key-value stores

commands.name: tags
commands.summary: List tags for a given instance

commands.name: tag-value
commands.summary: Get tag value for a specific instance

commands.name: tagged
commands.summary: List instances tagged by tag-string. Format: "tagname" or "tagname=tagvalue" or comma separated "tag0,tag1=val1,tag2" for intersection of all.

commands.name: tag
commands.summary: Add a tag to a given instance. Tag in "tagname" or "tagname=tagvalue" format

commands.name: untag
commands.summary: Remove a tag from an instance

commands.name: untag-all
commands.summary: Remove a tag from all matching instances

commands.name: discover
commands.summary: Lookup an instance, investigate it

commands.name: forget
commands.summary: Forget about an instance's existence

commands.name: begin-maintenance
commands.summary: Request a maintenance lock on an instance

commands.name: end-maintenance
commands.summary: Remove maintenance lock from an instance

commands.name: in-maintenance
commands.summary: Check whether instance is under maintenance

commands.name: begin-downtime
commands.summary: Mark an instance as downtimed

commands.name: end-downtime
commands.summary: Indicate an instance is no longer downtimed

commands.name: recover
commands.summary: Do auto-recovery given a dead instance

commands.name: recover-lite
commands.summary: Do auto-recovery given a dead instance. Orchestrator chooses the best course of actionwithout executing external processes

commands.name: force-master-failover
commands.summary: Forcibly discard master and initiate a failover, even if orchestrator doesn't see a problem. This command lets orchestrator choose the replacement master

commands.name: force-master-takeover
commands.summary: Forcibly discard master and promote another (direct child) instance instead, even if everything is running well

commands.name: graceful-master-takeover
commands.summary: Gracefully promote a new master. Either indicate identity of new master via '-d designated.instance.com' or setup replication tree to have a single direct replica to the master.

commands.name: graceful-master-takeover-auto
commands.summary: Gracefully promote a new master. orchestrator will attempt to pick the promoted replica automatically

commands.name: replication-analysis
commands.summary: Request an analysis of potential crash incidents in all known topologies

commands.name: ack-all-recoveries
commands.summary: Acknowledge all recoveries; this unblocks pending future recoveries

commands.name: ack-cluster-recoveries
commands.summary: Acknowledge recoveries for a given cluster; this unblocks pending future recoveries

commands.name: ack-instance-recoveries
commands.summary: Acknowledge recoveries for a given instance; this unblocks pending future recoveries

commands.name: register-candidate
commands.summary: Indicate that a specific instance is a preferred candidate for master promotion

commands.name: register-hostname-unresolve
commands.summary: Assigns the given instance a virtual (aka "unresolved") name

commands.name: deregister-hostname-unresolve
commands.summary: Explicitly deregister/dosassociate a hostname with an "unresolved" name

commands.name: set-heuristic-domain-instance
commands.summary: Associate domain name of given cluster with what seems to be the writer master for that cluster

commands.name: snapshot-topologies
commands.summary: Take a snapshot of existing topologies.

commands.name: active-nodes
commands.summary: List currently active orchestrator nodes

commands.name: resolve
commands.summary: Resolve given hostname

commands.name: reset-hostname-resolve-cache
commands.summary: Clear the hostname resolve cache

commands.name: show-resolve-hosts
commands.summary: Show the content of the hostname_resolve table. Generally used for debugging

commands.name: show-unresolve-hosts
commands.summary: Show the content of the hostname_unresolve table. Generally used for debugging

commands.name: custom-command
commands.summary: Execute a custom command on the agent as defined in the agent conf

commands.name: disable-global-recoveries
commands.summary: Disallow orchestrator from performing recoveries globally

commands.name: enable-global-recoveries
commands.summary: Allow orchestrator to perform recoveries globally

commands.name: check-global-recoveries
commands.summary: Show the global recovery configuration

commands.name: bulk-instances
commands.summary: Return a list of sorted instance names known to orchestrator

commands.name: bulk-promotion-rules
commands.summary: Return a list of promotion rules known to orchestrator

commands.name: async-discover
commands.summary: async-discover

commands.name: forget-cluster
commands.summary: forget-cluster

commands.name: can-replicate-from-gtid
commands.summary: can-replicate-from-gtid

commands.name: stop-replica-nice
commands.summary: stop-replica-nice

commands.name: delay-replication
commands.summary: delay-replication

commands.name: which-broken-replicas
commands.summary: which-broken-replicas

commands.name: which-cluster-osc-running-replicas
commands.summary: which-cluster-osc-running-replicas

commands.name: dominant-dc
commands.summary: dominant-dc

commands.name: raft-leader
commands.summary: raft-leader

commands.name: raft-health
commands.summary: raft-health

commands.name: raft-leader-hostname
commands.summary: raft-leader-hostname

commands.name: raft-configuration
commands.summary: raft-configuration

commands.name: raft-bootstrap
commands.summary: raft-bootstrap

commands.name: raft-add-member
commands.summary: raft-add-member

commands.name: raft-remove-member
commands.summary: raft-remove-member

commands.name: raft-transfer-leadership
commands.summary: raft-transfer-leadership

commands.name: raft-snapshot
commands.summary: raft-snapshot

commands.name: gtid-errant-inject-empty
commands.summary: Apply errant GTID as empty transactions on the cluster master

errors.note: ErrorClass is optional; legacy handlers may return HTTP errors without it.
